This seeds is found chiefly in cold climates, especially in sea coasts and saltwater shores, and is best known throughout Endor.

Even in suitable terrain, it remains easy to find.

To obtain its properties, it is used by direct application.

The seeds are ground and scattered over burned skin, relieving pain for about twelve hours. They keep for one year.
